text:
I've been there several times, seeing about three different dentists. One person had fillings, another had a wisdom tooth extracted. The first dentist for fillings was a man; he did a great job and was very polite. I paid cash for the wisdom tooth extraction. I saw a woman then, and the extraction took about half an hour to an hour. She was very grumpy. At that time, I had also had lip augmentation done several months earlier, and it was still a bit tight. I went for the extraction to prepare for orthodontics. The dentist scolded me until it was over. It was painful, tight, and swollen for almost two weeks. But I wasn't deterred and went back for more fillings. This time, I saw another female dentist who was lovely and kind. I also went for a teeth cleaning.
One day, I recommended a friend to go there, but unfortunately, they were half an hour late and the dentist had already left. I understand that, but when they arrived, they weren't willing to take them anymore (embarrassing, I recommended them and they didn't want to do it; the dentist might have been busy).
And I still wasn't deterred. I messaged their page, and the admin replied without reading properly. The page listed services like fillings and extractions using the government health insurance. I asked politely, and the admin replied, "You can't use the government health insurance." (I hadn't even asked about the government health insurance yet!!) They also didn't explain my needs. After about 10 minutes, they messaged again, explaining and asking us to schedule an appointment. We were disappointed too, you know.
